THE LISTENING FOREST 
Fig. 01   /   A trail shaped by light. Original landscape illustration. 
Follow the softer path. 
The forest changes the scale of things.
A leaf becomes a small landscape.
The smallest sounds travel further:
a branch, a wing, a drop of water.
There is a rhythm here that does
not belong to clocks. Walk until
you find yourself moving with it.
Stop where the path opens.
Look toward the brightest patch
of sky. Follow the layers of green
until they become separate trees.
Attention is a kind of arrival.
You do not have to travel far
to find a place worth noticing. 
FIELDNOTES   /   VOL. 01   04
